description: Erection of a 1.7m high obscured glazed privacy screen around part of the flat roof of the existing back addition at third floor level in connection with new use as a roof terrace; removal of existing sash window and replacement with door to provide access to the roof terrace at third floor level to the rear elevation.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following approved drawings, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

[ - Existing & Proposed Elevs Revision 2, Existing & Proposed Plans Revision 2]

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.

Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below: 

- Replacement doors: timber framed, painted white. 

- Terrace screening: 1.7m Obscure glass. 

The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate. 

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4, DC6 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 4 - The terrace hereby approved shall not be first used until the privacy screening has been installed as shown on the approved drawings. The privacy screen shall achieve a minimum level of obscurity equivalent to Pilkington Texture Glass Level 3 and shall have a height of 1.7m  above the finished floor level of the terrace along the rear and side elevations. The privacy screen shall thereafter be permanently retained as approved. 

To protect the amenities of neighbouring occupiers in terms of overlooking and privacy in accordance with Policy HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 5 - Other than the area identified on the approved drawings as a roof terrace, no other part of the roof of the back addition or any other roof of the existing building shall be used as a terrace. No alterations shall be carried out; nor planters or other chattels placed on the other roofs, and no railings or other means of enclosure shall be erected around the roofs and no alterations shall be carried out to the rear or side elevations of the application property to form an access onto the other roofs.
									 
Such a use would be detrimental to the amenities of neighbouring properties by reason of overlooking and loss of privacy and potential noise and disturbance, contrary to Policies HO11, CC11 and CC13 of the Local Plan (2018) and Key Principles HS1 and HS8 of the Planning Guidance Supplementary Planning Document (2018).
